desc:
🧗 No auto-climb. Every hand, every foot, every fall is on you.
Move each limb yourself, manage your grip, chalk up, and dyno when the next hold is out of reach. If you miss, you fall off the wall.

⛰️ WHAT’S INSIDE

Bouldering gym from VB to V18
Tilting Kilter Board: set your own climbs
Build your own gyms with friends using the create feature!
Auto-belay walls + outdoor crags + lead climbing
Big wall with trad gear placement
Belay your friends 🤝
World leaderboards + ranks 🏆
Progress through the skill tree

CHEATING OR USE OF GAME BREAKING BUGS TO GAIN AN ADVANTAGE WILL RESULT IN A PERMANENT BAN

PC CONTROLS
Q/E: hands | Z/C: feet
Click or same key: grab
Right-click: put limb back
Hold Space: dyno to cursor
WASD: rock/swing
V: let go | F: cut feet
R: shake out | 1: chalk
T: place gear
F: start climb | H: all controls

📱 Mobile + controller supported!
